# Synthetic M1 fixture

`m1_openalex.jsonl` uses native-shaped OpenAlex JSON records with expressly synthetic `fixture:openalex:*` identifiers. It is authored for software regression, not fetched from OpenAlex, derived from a paper's DOIs, or part of the original benchmark.

Two source author IDs share a name. Four distinct works include a second version of one work and an out-of-window distractor. The two versions retain different title observations. The fixture exercises the bounded M1 publication-count path; the complete Institute X 14/31/site/causal fixture is M3 work and is not claimed here.
